restore.wizardDescription: Restore a tenant as a new copy or the entire installation from a restore point.
restore.ownerOnly: Only owner administrators can start restores.
restore.kindTenantHelp: Creates a NEW tenant with the state of the restore point. The existing tenant stays unchanged.

restore.noTenants: No tenants in the restore point
restore.newNameHelp: The name should differ from the existing tenant.
restore.targetProfileHelp: Files are written to a new generation of this profile - existing data stays untouched.
restore.previewHint: The preview checks version, schema, target and risks before anything is changed.
restore.skipRescue: Continue without a rescue point of the current state (not recommended)
restore.totpHelp: Fresh confirmation with the authenticator of your admin account.

restore.importWarnings: {count, plural, one {# import note} other {# import notes}}
